components.css: .ds-nav{min-height:94px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#416065);color:var(--paper,#f4efdf);font:400 12px/1.7 var(--body,Manrope,Arial,sans-serif)}.ds-nav a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-wordmark{font:400 32px/1 var(--display,'Bodoni Moda','Times New Roman',serif);letter-spacing:-.02em}.ds-wordmark span{color:var(--rose,#e5b7ad);padding:0 5px}.ds-date{letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted,#b4c7c6)}.ds-nav-action{min-height:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rose,#e5b7ad);outline-offset:6px}@media(max-width:800px){.ds-nav{min-height:72px}.ds-date{display:none}}@media(max-width:580px){.ds-nav{min-height:66px}.ds-wordmark{font-size:26px}}

components.css: .ds-event{display:grid;grid-template-columns:94px minmax(0,1fr) 28px;gap:28px;padding:30px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#416065);color:var(--paper,#f4efdf);font:400 14px/1.7 var(--body,Manrope,Arial,sans-serif)}.ds-time{margin:0;padding-top:6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--rose,#e5b7ad);white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-event-name{margin:0;font:400 clamp(26px,2.6vw,35px)/1.1 var(--display,'Bodoni Moda','Times New Roman',serif)}.ds-event-line{margin:9px 0 0;color:var(--muted,#b4c7c6)}@media(max-width:800px){.ds-event{grid-template-columns:75px 1fr;gap:12px}}@media(max-width:580px){.ds-event{grid-template-columns:68px minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px;padding:24px 0}.ds-event-name{font-size:27px}}

narrative.overview: The implemented evening world pairs midnight teal with warm moonwhite lettering and blush accents. Editorial type, open programme rows and framed origami imagery make the invitation intimate and ceremonial without obscuring practical details.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, tonal surfaces with one contrasting countdown band.
Expressive serif names beside quiet, legible sans-serif information.
Arched imagery and a glowing doorway as recurring signatures.

rules.name: The Evening Rule
rules.body: Keep the invitation's midnight-teal foundation; the earlier burgundy/gold and Comic Sans glass treatment is superseded.

dos: Do preserve the evening palette, serif/sans hierarchy and arched image language.
Do keep programme text, keyboard focus and touch targets clear on mobile.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences and retain usable media controls.
donts: Don't restore the superseded burgundy/gold or Comic Sans glass styling.
Don't turn the open programme into a grid of elevated cards.
Don't spread portal glow, blur or ornamental animation across ordinary content.
